verdict.rationale: Gusto publishes an official CLI repo (Gusto/gusto-cli), described as a 'public developer interface' and explicitly 'Agent-friendly', with documented commands for auth, employees, pay schedules and skill installation. That directly meets the AI-native official-CLI story. The evidence is limited to a GitHub README summary. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs (install, command reference, scope and stability), independent or hands-on corroboration that the CLI works for agent workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Official repo github.com/Gusto/gusto-cli, description "Gusto CLI - public developer interface"; README tagline: "Agent-friendly developer interface for Gusto payroll."
